name: Twitter / X tracking
description: Share-sheet and referrer params on twitter.com and x.com.

name: Instagram tracking
description: Share grid id appended to shared Instagram links.

name: Instagram share tokens
description: Shared reel, post and IGTV links carry a share token under a rotating random parameter name, so a name list cannot keep up. On share paths only (/reel, /reels, /p, /tv), keep only functional params: hl (UI language), img_index (carousel slide), next (post-login redirect), q (keyword search), variant (Following/Favorites feed). Other paths keep their params, so account flows such as password reset are not at risk. Exact hosts only: l.instagram.com is a redirect wrapper whose u must survive.

name: Instagram page tokens
description: Profile and other non-share links also carry a share token under a rotating random parameter name (e.g. dlrf, obrf). Site-wide keepOnly at priority 200, so on share paths social.instagram-web (priority 100) wins. Keeps the share-path params plus account flows: password reset (uidb36, token, s, is_caa, afv, from a real reset email's param names) and OAuth (client_id, redirect_uri, response_type, scope, state, enable_fb_login, force_reauth, per Meta's Business Login for Instagram docs). Exact hosts only, like social.instagram-web.

name: Facebook tracking
description: Action/referrer/notification tracking on Facebook hosts. fbclid handled globally.

name: YouTube cleanup
description: Keep only the params that affect playback; strip everything else (feature, si, pp, etc.).

name: New York Times share tracking
description: Share-attribution params on links shared from NYT (e.g. ?smid=nytcore-ios-share&referringSource=articleShare&sgrp=c-cb). All four are stripped on nytimes.com by AdGuard's URL Tracking filter (AdguardFilters #180304); ClearURLs strips smid. Gift links keep unlocked_article_code, which unlocks the article.
